Title: MemorySmith.Agent — AgentBackgroundService Runtime Lifecycle
Content:
AgentBackgroundService (WebUI.Blazor, ~3557 lines) is the IHostedService that owns the entire agent runtime. It is a monolithic hosted service — the Sprint 39 decomposition attempt (AgentRuntime, RecoveryManagerImpl, etc.) left .bak files but the production code remains un-refactored.

## Lifecycle

Starting → Connecting → Planning → Dispatching → Settling → Replanning → Completing → Stopping

ExecuteAsync (line 590) manages reconnection with max 5 attempts and exponential backoff (2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s). On connect: loads cross-session facts via LoadSessionFactsAsync (Sprint 54, uses IMemoryGateway), enqueues Chat presence message, launches 4 concurrent loops via Task.WhenAll.

## Four Concurrent Loops

### 1. ProcessEventsAsync (line 687)
Reads from worldAdapter.ReceiveEventsAsync(), applies WorldStateProjector, routes events to correlation tracking and goal evaluation. Handles health delta detection for damage interrupt. Switch handles 26+ event types with default branch logging at LogDebug.

### 2. DispatchActionsAsync (line 1831)
The core control loop:
- Phase 1: Check goal completion/failure → check replan governor → check stale inventory → call planner.PlanAsync → enqueue actions
- Phase 2: Dequeue and dispatch one action with correlation tracking. Includes fire-and-forget concurrency limits (MaxConcurrentForTool: PlaceBlock=8 via _maxConcurrentPlaceBlock, others=1) and per-tool timeout overrides
- Phase 3: Progress detection via inventory sum comparison, game error recovery (TryRecoverFromGameErrorAsync at line 3649), stall detection, sweep timed-out actions (SweepTimedOutActions at line 2754; per-tool timeouts: place=15s, GetStatus=10s, MoveTo=10s, Wander=15s, mine=15s, SmeltItem=45s, others=30s default)
- Phase 4: ILlmEvaluator replan check → loop back. Includes circuit breaker (3 consecutive failures → 60s cooldown, lines 230-232, 2204-2276)
- Pre-dispatch snapshot: _preDispatchSnapshot (WorldState) captured before each dispatch (Sprint 55 TSK-0155)
- WorldModel.Predict() enriches WorldStateDiff with expected gains/losses (Sprint 58 TSK-0309)

### 3. ChatConsumerAsync (line 1208)
Single-reader Channel<WorldEvent>, reads _chatChannel and calls HandleChatEventAsync. Routes intents to goal creation (including TaskSequenceGoal for multi-step chaining from Sprint 54 TSK-0205), cancellation (CancelGoal at line 385), status queries, or LLM clarification. Handles chat response splitting (chatMaxResponseLength, Sprint 54 TSK-0199).

### 4. InventorySyncLoopAsync (line 1231)
Periodic inventory refresh every 30 seconds. Calls GetStatus to get authoritative server-side inventory and reconcile with projected state. Added Sprint 57 (TSK-0302) to prevent silent inventory drift.

## Synchronization Mechanisms

- ActionQueue: ConcurrentQueue<ActionData> + lock for bulk ops
- _correlatedActions: ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, PendingAction> with CAS loop (TryUpdate) for thread-safe state transitions
- _chatChannel: single-reader/single-writer Channel<WorldEvent> (System.Threading.Channels)
- _gameErrors: single-writer Channel<string>
- _pendingLock: lock for _pendingActions list
- _cycleOutcomes: ConcurrentQueue<ActionOutcome>
- _queue.ClearAndEnqueueAsync(): async stop callback BEFORE lock-protected clear + enqueue (prevents deadlock, Sprint 36 P0-A, line ~1182)
- _placeBlockContexts: ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, (string BlueprintId, int BlockIndex)> for PlaceBlock build checkpoint tracking (Sprint 42, line 203)
- _preDispatchSnapshot: WorldState snapshot before dispatch (Sprint 55 TSK-0155) for observe→compare→evaluate replan loop
- _worldModel: IWorldModel for predict-before-dispatch and reconcile-after-completion (Sprint 58 TSK-0309)
- _blockTimeoutCounts: ConcurrentDictionary<int, int> for auto-skip after 3 consecutive place timeouts (Sprint 54 TSK-0226)
- _consecutiveGetStatusTimeouts: clears IsInventoryStale after 2 consecutive timeouts (Sprint 54 TSK-0221)
- _llmEvalSuppressUntil: DateTimeOffset circuit breaker timestamp for LLM evaluator cooldown (line 231, Sprint 58 Wave C)
- _consecutiveLlmEvalFailures: int counter, resets on success (line 230)
- MaxConcurrentForTool: dispatch gate at line 2689 ("place" → _maxConcurrentPlaceBlock, all others → 1)
- _goalProvisioningCts: CancellationTokenSource for creative provisioning loop (line 244, Sprint 58 Wave D TSK-0331)
- _lastAbandonedGoalName: prevents immediate re-creation of abandoned goals
- _lastDamageInterruptAt: rate-limiter for damage interrupt (3s cooldown)
- _firstLowHealthTime: debounce for sustained low health detection (3000ms default)

## TaskSequenceGoal Integration

- Created by ChatConsumerAsync for multi-step chat intents (Sprint 54 TSK-0205)
- Step advancement via ResetForNextSequenceStep (line ~3468)
- LLM evaluator delegates to current step's context (Sprint 59 TSK-0320)
